The {{tt|Great Canyon of Poni|Vast Poni Canyon}}!'') is the 23rd chapter of the {{MangaArc|Sun, Moon, Ultra Sun & Ultra Moon}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} {{Incomplete plot}} ==Major events== * {{p|Crabominable}} returns, asking to join [[Hapu]]'s [[Party|team]]. When Hapu refuses and suggests it join {{adv|Sun}}, Crabominable reluctantly agrees and is [[nickname]]d Loot. * Hapu reveals she is in possession of the [[Moon Flute]]. * [[Gladion]] and [[Lillie]] head to the [[Poni Altar]], but are attacked by a {{p|Xurkitree}}. * [[Faba]] and the {{tc|Aether Foundation Employee}}s arrive at [[Vast Poni Canyon]] and split into two groups: one to capture Hapu, and the other to head to the Poni Altar. * [[Plumeria]] confronts Faba, demanding to know where [[Guzma]] was taken to. * Plumeria reveals she has the {{p|Cosmog}} Guzma received from the [[Aether Foundation]], though it has since [[Evolution|evolved]] into a {{p|Cosmoem}}. * {{adv|Moon}} and [[Anabel]] arrive to confront Faba. * Faba has the Employees battle in his place while he tries to escape. * [[Nebby]] and the other Cosmoem fly into the air and meet each other. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Sun}} * {{adv|Moon}} * [[Lillie]] * [[Ilima]] (flashback) * [[Kiawe]] (flashback) * [[Mallow]] (flashback) * [[Hapu]] * [[Hau]] (flashback) * [[Anabel]] * [[Gladion]] * [[Guzma]] (flashback) * [[Plumeria]] * [[Lusamine]] (fantasy) * [[Faba]] * {{tc|Aether Foundation Employee}}s ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Meowth}} ([[Alolan form]];
